surfaces.name: catalog_settings
shows: Contract Product Lines showing reusable Product Line + owning Contract + current policy revision/lifecycle
policy revision history and exact tier table including visibly derived Non-fault inquiry rows
actions: create/edit/archive catalog records under dependency guards
create/revise policy from IT/NFV template or explicit base-severity tiers
configure/supersede Customer Account Code classification mappings

surfaces.name: sr_classification
rules: discarded Advanced Search Product is never rendered as classification authority
unclassified and classified-but-uncalculable are visually/textually distinct
cross-customer CPL is visibly incompatible rather than hidden as mysterious failure

surfaces.name: batch_classification
rules: no loaded-page count substitutes for exact total
batch apply reports each target independently and never implies all-or-nothing success

surfaces.name: individual_sla
shows: each applicable tier threshold and individual state
rules: cohort percentage result is not represented as an individual deadline status
source ResolveBy fields do not appear as Beta SLA authority

surfaces.name: cohort_review
rules: Objective timezone control does not appear here
open or still-changing cohort never displays Final Met
individual drilldown preserves exact member state

surfaces.name: reporting
shows: completed artifact hash/size and immutable completed timestamp

working_copy_rule: Policy and classification edits are UI working copies until exact preview/base-state validation and domain command commit. Stale state receives refreshed review, never last-write-wins.
accessibility: Every state/warning uses text and/or iconography in addition to color; exact percentages/durations remain available in detail even when presentation rounds for readability.
